scientific_question: Can verified reference-guided real multifile repair and timely completion demonstrations improve new-family repository repair and submission under a common fixed budget?

data_policy.new_demonstrations: upstream_reference_guided, actually executed, reference patch and localization supplied; not autonomous teacher rollouts
data_policy.selection: All 50 CPU-admitted historical training candidates attempted once; reject whole episodes that exceed actual token/action/context budgets or fail expected execution/fresh protected grading. No model-score selection or action filtering.
data_policy.feasibility_revision: Private initial planning target of 12 multifile demonstrations was infeasible in the screened pool under 512 target tokens per call. Before any 032 model generation or update, register >=6 ablation-verified complete multifile episodes and >=32 total episodes. This does not change the model acceptance threshold.
data_policy.ablation: At least two production files each cause semantic regression when individually reverted from the upstream fixed state.
data_policy.reference_test_policy: Public upstream regression tests, protected fresh-copy regrading; not secret tests.
data_policy.data_gate_failure: Do not start candidate training; retain and report rejected episodes.

candidate.initialization: verified pinned base, never a previous adapter
candidate.lora_target_profile: same language-model module expression as capacity-profile.json
candidate.loss: assistant target tokens only; mean supervised-token loss per record, averaged over actual record count in each accumulation window
candidate.order: sort action records by SHA256 of UTF8(025-student-v1 plus literal NUL plus record id); one pass, all eligible records exactly once
candidate.checkpoint_selection: only end of the complete epoch; no development-driven selection or retry
required_integrity: all frozen parameters have no gradients
all loss and gradient norms finite
saved adapter reload matches a training-only greedy probe

development.runtime_intervention: none; common non-thinking policy, no submission guard or per-arm prompts
development.selection: Fixed CPU candidate inventory, ablation-verified multifile first, then original history order; first six per family passing two additional fixed/parent repeatability checks. No model scores used.
development.primary_score: independent grader passes AND explicit submit AND actor budget compliant
secondary_scores: patch correct within budget regardless of submit
standalone visible verification matches final source
development.normalization: Same024 extended normalization plus direct Node TAP diagnostic timing fields. Raw output capped before normalization; nested assertion values preserved.
development.task_scope: Public upstream historical regression tests visible; fresh protected regrading. New task-source families to this project, not a pretraining decontamination claim.

analysis.primary_effect: multifile032 minus base on per-task average explicit correct completion across three repeats
analysis.uncertainty: paired hierarchical family then task bootstrap; all repeats kept together; 10000 draws seed32032
analysis.matched_budget: Same actor calls, generated tokens, context and wall-time limits for all three variants. Candidate training compute is not matched to031.
